programme.title: Rick and Morty - Jer Bud

programme.title: Rick and Morty - Erickerhead

programme.title: The Terrors of Jordan Mendoza - Found a Leprechaun
programme.desc: Found this leprechaun; went to war and my best friend died, but there's a therapy that will make that okay.

programme.title: The Terrors of Jordan Mendoza - Sometimes I Feel Haunted.
programme.desc: Dream where I explore a haunted hospital; it's fine except Steve got a terminal diagnosis; I hope he's okay.

programme.title: Dragon Ball Daima - Thieves
programme.desc: Rumors of what Goku did in the Third Demon World spread across the Demon Realm; to avoid trouble, Goku wears a disguise at the hotel, but they can't let their guard down.

programme.title: Dragon Ball Daima - Ocean
programme.desc: Goku and his companions arrive at the Second Demon World where a giant ocean spreads as far as the eye can see; the party is amazed at the new world but is immediately attacked by Gendarmerie that have been sent by Gomah.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball - The Code
programme.desc: After learning they cannot live without Wi-Fi, Gumball and Darwin try to obtain Mr. Robinson's passcode so they can go online again.

programme.desc: Carrie backs up Gumball's story about a monster, and the students want to hire them as ghost exterminators for Halloween candy.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball - The Test
programme.desc: When he is labeled a "loser" in an online test, Gumball believes he must do the opposite of everything he would normally do.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball - The Slide
programme.desc: Rocky decides to stop living life online, and find love on a dating app, and Gumball and Darwin try to help him.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball - The Loophole
programme.desc: Gumball and Darwin give Bobert instructions so he will behave in a safe and responsible manner, but he applies the logic to their rules.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball - The Copycats
programme.desc: Gumball and Darwin are confused when they meet Kiki and Quack, a pair of siblings that copy everything they do and say; Gumball and Darwin find out this copycat family is making money online from imitating the Watterson family.

programme.title: Regular Show - Replaced
programme.desc: Benson tries to replace Mordecai and Rigby with an ostrich and a possum.

programme.title: Regular Show - Trash Boat
programme.desc: Rigby changes his name, then has to change it back.

programme.title: Regular Show - Fists of Justice
programme.desc: Mordecai and Rigby do all of Skips' duties for the day as a birthday gift.

programme.title: Regular Show - Yes Dude Yes

programme.desc: Mordecai and Rigby can't sleep because of the beep.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings - Thermal Shock!
programme.desc: Just as Grizzy settles into the couch by the fireside, the Lemmings come charging into the living room on their new mount, the vacuum cleaner; irritated, the bear throws the mechanical charger into the fireplace, which blows up.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings - Primitive Activities
programme.desc: The Lemmings have a new playmate: a walrus; the rodents ride the creature throughout the cabin, then make him slide down the roof before starting all over again; Grizzy steps in and propels the creature to the back of a mysterious ice cave.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings - Cabin On Ice

programme.desc: When Darwin has lunch with Idaho, he decides to stop eating potatoes in solidarity with his brotato; Darwin finds his obsession with his favorite food harder to kick than he ever imagined, so Gumball decides to help his friend curb his carb cravings.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball - The Fuss
programme.desc: Nicole tries, and fails, to hide her disappointment when Richard and the kids fail to remember her special day; Richard has to figure out what special day he has actually forgotten and then make it a day to remember or else.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball - The Console
